$AUVEN / SOLANA

The role of
$AUVEN.

Link a Solana wallet to your AUVEN account to check its $AUVEN balance and create a post-quantum signed holder proof for an agent. Your tokens stay in your wallet. Agent controls and signed activity work with or without $AUVEN.

$AUVEN IN THE PRODUCT

What is live, what comes next.

Wallet balance checks and signed holder proofs are the first token features. Higher limits and token payments are planned; their rules and prices have not been set.

BUYBACK AND BURN / PLANNED

Use service revenue to buy and burn $AUVEN.

We plan to use a defined share of AUVEN service revenue to buy $AUVEN and burn the purchased tokens. We will publish the share, timing, and transaction records before this starts. Buybacks and burns are not active today.

AUVEN service revenue→Buy $AUVEN→Burn purchased tokens
POST-QUANTUM PROOF

A record you can
check yourself.

Agent passports, activity checkpoints, and holder proofs use ML-DSA-65 signatures that you can export and verify. A separate Solana transaction can record a proof commitment when publication is configured.

$AUVEN on Solana.
